articles.title: Ice gives way at Arunachal’s Sela Lake, two Kerala tourists drown
articles.summary: Tragically, the bodies of two young tourists from Kerala have been recovered from the high-altitude Sela Lake in Arunachal Pradesh's Tawang. The incident occurred when three individuals from their group fell through the lake's frozen surface on Friday. This unfortunate accident serves as a stark reminder for adventure enthusiasts to exercise extreme caution and adhere to safety guidelines when exploring challenging natural environments.

articles.title: Facing dwindling numbers, Kerala Church’s appeal – ‘Actively come to politics, public governance’
articles.summary: The Syro-Malabar Catholic Church in Kerala has advised its members against extensive overseas migration. Facing declining community numbers within the state, the Church urged its faithful to actively engage in politics and pursue government jobs locally. This strategy aims to strengthen the community's presence and influence in Kerala, prioritizing internal development and leadership over seeking opportunities abroad.

articles.title: Umno AGM: Wrongdoings by a few do not reflect actions of the whole armed forces, says Khaled
articles.summary: Malaysian Defence Minister Datuk Seri Mohamed Khaled Nordin clarified that isolated incidents of wrongdoing within the armed forces do not reflect the integrity of the entire military. He emphasized the importance of maintaining public trust and the forces' positive image, urging all personnel to uphold high standards of conduct. This statement aims to reassure citizens and reaffirm the commitment of the vast majority of servicemen.
